metadata.question: Did the area of open water around Bay Dosgris, south of New Orleans, increase from 1985 to 2024 relative to wetland areas?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Bay Dosgris, south of New Orleans, Louisiana - Time periods: 1985 vs 2024 - Collection: Landsat for long-term comparison (Landsat 5 for 1985, Landsat 8/9 for 2024) - Need to classify water vs wetland/vegetation 2. Masking strategy: - Cloud masking is important for accurate classification - Use NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) to identify water - Use NDVI to help distinguish wetland vegetation - Compare water area ratio between the two periods 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Water area calculation returns 0 or valid percentage - C1: No images found for either period - C2: After cloud masking, no valid pixels remain - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN or invalid values - A: Water area increased (higher water-to-land ratio in 2024) - B: Water area did not increase Bay Dosgris is in the Louisiana coastal wetlands. I'll define a geometry around this area and compare water extent. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions // Bay Dosgris area, south of New Orleans const geom = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-89.35, 29.25], [-89.35, 29.40], [-89.15, 29.40], [-89.15, 29.25], [-89.35, 29.25]] ]); // 2. Data Acquisition for 1985 (Landsat 5) const col1985 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(geom) .filterDate('1985-01-01', '1985-12-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const size1985 = await col1985.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1985 Images: ${size1985}`); if (size1985 === 0) { console.log('No data for 1985.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Data Acquisition for 2024 (Landsat 9) let col2024 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(geom) .filterDate('2024-01-01', '2024-12-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); let size2024 = await col2024.size().getInfo(); if (size2024 === 0) { col2024 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(geom) .filterDate('2024-01-01', '2024-12-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); size2024 = await col2024.size().getInfo(); } console.log(`2024 Images: ${size2024}`); if (size2024 === 0) { console.log('No data for 2024.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Processing function function maskClouds(image) { const qaMask = image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(parseInt('11111', 2)).eq(0); const satMask = image.select('QA_RADSAT').eq(0); return image.updateMask(qaMask).updateMask(satMask); } function calculateWater(image) { const green = image.select('SR_B2').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); const nir = image.select('SR_B4').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); const ndwi = green.subtract(nir).divide(green.add(nir)).rename('NDWI'); const water = ndwi.gt(0.3); return water; } // 5. Calculate water area for 1985 const img1985 = col1985.map(maskClouds).median(); const water1985 = calculateWater(img1985); const stats1985 = await water1985.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: geom, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const waterPixels1985 = stats1985.NDWI_sum || 0; const totalPixels1985 = stats1985.NDWI_count || 0; if (totalPixels1985 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for 1985 after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } const waterRatio1985 = waterPixels1985 / totalPixels1985; // 6. Calculate water area for 2024 const img2024 = col2024.map(maskClouds).median(); const water2024 = calculateWater(img2024); const stats2024 = await water2024.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: geom, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const waterPixels2024 = stats2024.NDWI_sum || 0; const totalPixels2024 = stats2024.NDWI_count || 0; if (totalPixels2024 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for 2024 after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } const waterRatio2024 = waterPixels2024 / totalPixels2024; // 7. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`1985: Water=${waterPixels1985}, Total=${totalPixels1985}, Ratio=${(waterRatio1985*100).toFixed(2)}%`); console.log(`2024: Water=${waterPixels2024}, Total=${totalPixels2024}, Ratio=${(waterRatio2024*100).toFixed(2)}%`); if (waterRatio1985 == null || waterRatio2024 == null || isNaN(waterRatio1985) || isNaN(waterRatio2024)) { console.log('C3'); } else if (waterRatio2024 > waterRatio1985) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
